blocks.title: Stoichiometry
blocks.text: Stoichiometry chemistry ki woh branch hai jo balanced chemical equation mein reactants aur products ka miqdari (quantitative) taalluq batati hai.
Mole, Avogadro’s number, molar mass, molar volume aur molar concentration ko jaan kar hum balanced chemical equation se reactants aur products ke darmiyan miqdaron ka taalluq bana sakte hain.
Stoichiometric relationships
Balanced chemical equation ki madad se yeh qism ke taalluqat parhe ja sakte hain:
In taalluqat ko samajhne ke liye balanced equation mein chhupi maloomat parhni hoti hai. Misal ke taur par:
Yeh equation chaar tareeqon se parhi ja sakti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai “three different ways” (teen tareeqe), lekin neeche chaar tareeqe diye hain: moles, molecules, volume aur mass.

items: N₂ ka 1 mole H₂ ke 3 moles se react kar ke NH₃ ke 2 moles banata hai.
N₂ ka 1 molecule H₂ ke 3 molecules se react kar ke NH₃ ke 2 molecules banata hai.
STP par 22.4 dm³ N₂, 67.2 dm³ H₂ se react kar ke 44.8 dm³ NH₃ banata hai.
28.0 g N₂, 6 g H₂ se react kar ke 34.0 g NH₃ banata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text:
Stoichiometric hisab karte waqt yeh baatein maan li jati hain (assumptions):
1) Sab reactants poori tarah products mein badal jate hain.
2) Law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions poore hote hain.
3) Koi side reaction nahi hoti.
Stoichiometric hisab karne ka tareeqa

blocks.alt: Paanch gol konon wale dabbe oopar se neeche, teeron se jure: peela (maloom thos ka mass, maloom gas ka hajm ya maloom solution ki molar concentration), hara (mutalliqa formula se maloom ke moles), surkh (balanced muadle se maloom aur na-maloom ka tanasub), neela (na-maloom ke moles) aur narangi (na-maloom ke moles ko mass, hajm ya concentration mein badalna).
blocks.caption: Stoichiometric hisabat ka tareeqa (kitab ke safha 82 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har sawal isi raste par hal hota hai: (1) jo cheez di gayi hai (mass, gas ka volume ya concentration) us se (2) moles nikalein, (3) balanced equation se mole ratio dekhein, (4) is ratio se mutloob (unknown) cheez ke moles nikalein, (5) phir un moles ko mass, volume ya concentration mein badal dein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke khaake ke teesre dabbe mein “unknow” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “unknown” (na-maloom) hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.11 (Mole-Mole)
blocks.problem: Jab 3.3 mole nitrogen, hydrogen se react kar ke ammonia banati hai to kitne moles hydrogen kharch hoti hai? N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g)
steps: N₂ ke moles = 3.3 mol; H₂ ke moles = ?
Equation se: 1 mole N₂ ko 3 mole H₂ chahiye
blocks.answer: 3.3 mole N₂ ko H₂ chahiye = 3 × 3.3 = 9.9 mol

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki aakhri satar mein “3.6 moles of N₂” likha hai jabke sawal 3.3 mol ka hai; hisab 3 × 3.3 = 9.9 mol sahi hai.
Quick Check 4.5

blocks.prompt: Jab ek insaan 2.25 moles glucose istemal karta hai (oxygen zyada maujood hai) to carbon dioxide ke kitne moles bante hain? Equation neeche hai.
blocks.explanation: Equation mein 1 mol glucose se 6 mol CO₂ bante hain. Is liye 2.25 x 6 = 13.5 mol CO₂.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.12 (Mass-Mass)
blocks.problem: 32.0 g iron (III) oxide se poori tarah react karne ke liye kitna Al chahiye? 2Al(s) + Fe₂O₃(s) → Al₂O₃(s) + 2Fe(s)
steps: Fe₂O₃ ka molar mass M = 159.6 g mol⁻¹
Fe₂O₃ ke moles n = m ÷ M = 32.0 g ÷ 159.6 g mol⁻¹ = 0.200 mol
Equation se: 1 mol Fe₂O₃, 2 mol Al se react karta hai; to Al ke moles = 2 x 0.200 = 0.401 mol
Al ka mass = n x M = 0.401 mol x 27 g mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne 32.0 ÷ 159.6 = 0.02 mol likha, phir Al = 0.04 mol aur jawab 1.08 g. Divide ka sahi jawab 0.200 mol hai, is liye Al = 0.401 mol aur mass = 10.8 g.
Quick Check 4.6

blocks.prompt: Fe₂O₃ (hematite, lohe ki khaan ka patthar) ko CO se reduce kar ke Fe hasil hota hai (equation neeche). 160 g Fe₂O₃ se kitna Fe banega?
blocks.explanation: Fe₂O₃ ke moles = 160 ÷ 159.6 = 1.0 mol. Equation mein 1 mol Fe₂O₃ se 2 mol Fe. Fe ka mass = 2.0 x 55.8 = taqreeban 112 g.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.13 (Volume-Volume)
blocks.problem: STP par 100 dm³ hydrogen zyada nitrogen se react kare to kitna ammonia banega? N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g)
steps: 67.2 dm³ (3 mol) H₂ se ammonia = 44.8 dm³ (2 mol)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Gases mein (ek hi temperature aur pressure par) volumes ka ratio wahi hota hai jo moles ka ratio. Is liye 3 : 2 ka ratio seedha volume par laga sakte hain.
Quick Check 4.7

blocks.prompt: STP par 4.5 dm³ methane jalane se (oxygen zyada hai) kitna carbon dioxide banta hai? Equation neeche hai.
blocks.explanation: Equation mein 1 mol CH₄ se 1 mol CO₂; gases mein volume ka ratio bhi 1 : 1. Is liye 4.5 dm³ CO₂.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.14 (Mole-Mass)
blocks.problem: Space gaariyon (space vehicles) mein solid lithium hydroxide, LiOH, saans se nikli CO₂ ko hatata hai aur solid lithium carbonate aur pani banata hai. 20.0 mol LiOH se kitna Li₂CO₃ banega? 2LiOH(s) + CO₂(g) → Li₂CO₃(s) + H₂O(l)
steps: Equation se: 2 moles LiOH se 1 mole Li₂CO₃
Mass = moles × molar mass = 10.0 mol × 73.9 g mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Quick Check 4.8

blocks.prompt: 2.25 moles chlorine, zyada sodium hydroxide se react kar ke kitna sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl, ghar ka bleach) banati hai? Equation neeche hai.
blocks.explanation: Equation mein 1 mol Cl₂ se 1 mol NaOCl. NaOCl ka molar mass = 23 + 16 + 35.5 = 74.5 g/mol. Mass = 2.25 x 74.5 = 167.6 g.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.15 (Mass-Mole)
blocks.problem: Baking soda (NaHCO₃) antacid hai; yeh maide (stomach) ka zyada hydrochloric acid neutralize karta hai: NaHCO₃(s) + HCl(aq) → NaCl(aq) + H₂O(l) + CO₂(g). 2.1 g baking soda kitne moles HCl neutralize karega?
steps: NaHCO₃ ka molar mass = 84.0 g mol⁻¹
NaHCO₃ ke moles = 2.1 g ÷ 84.0 g mol⁻¹ = 0.025 mol
Equation mein HCl aur NaHCO₃ ka mole ratio 1 : 1 hai

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein baking soda ko NaHCO₃(g) (gas) likha hai. Baking soda solid hai: NaHCO₃(s).

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.16 (Mass-Volume)
blocks.problem: 7.0 g iron zyada sulphuric acid se react kare to STP par kitni hydrogen banegi? Fe(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → FeSO₄(aq) + H₂(g)
steps: Equation se 1 mol Fe se 1 mol H₂, to H₂ = 0.125 mol
Volume = molar volume x moles = 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹ x 0.125 mol

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Balanced equation moles, molecules, volume (STP) aur mass ke ratios deti hai: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ mein 1 : 3 : 2 mol, 22.4 : 67.2 : 44.8 dm³, 28.0 : 6 : 34.0 g.
Tareeqa: di hui cheez → moles → mole ratio → mutloob cheez ke moles → mass, volume ya concentration.
